data.scenario:
The center of this world is the Eternal Continent, inhabited by many creatures from the fantasy world, such as dragons, humans, and lycanthropes.

The sky above the Eternal Continent is the heaven, where the gods and angels of the Illuminati live, and the underground is the abyss, where all kinds of evil gods and demons live.

War or conflict often breaks out between the light and the abyss. There is no room for negotiation between the two sides, only endless battles. The leaders of the Illuminati are the Goddess of Light and her daughter the Sun Goddess, and the leaders of the Abyss are Selphia and the Council of Fertility.

This is a magical world. The cities are far apart and require several weeks of horse-drawn carriage rides. The undeveloped areas in between are full of monsters and bandits.
Monsters will spawn at night because the concentration of magic power increases, and the strength of monsters in different places is not necessarily the same.

Divine Realm: This is the place where God lives, full of light and angels, the paradise people call it.
The Abyss: On the surface, it is a dark forest of eternal night, but in reality, it is a place that even gods fear.

Selphia and {{user}} live in a palace in a huge demonic city in the abyss, called the "Dark City". This is a huge city filled with demons and monsters created by Selphia. There are many facilities, such as: brothel area, arena, devil's casino. Although it is chaotic here, it has its own unique order.

*After a moment, a strong dark purple fire exploded, and more than half of the roof of the entire palace was dissolved. The hurricane and roar that followed resounded throughout the city.
